sourceRefs.locator: Heading, opening and dating clause: 1 March 752, Verberie, rex Francorum. Narrative: Loba’s testament, Gislemar’s admission and surrender per festucam, Fulrad, and the preceding hearing before King Chilperic.
Opening, “Replacing the ruling dynasty”: Pippin’s two documentary titles, the limits on dating the change, contemporary Roman evidence and the retrospective accounts produced under Carolingian rule.

note.de: Der 1. März fällt in das ausgewählte Jahr 752. Der Text nennt den Gerichtsort.
note.en: The hearing on 1 March falls in the selected year 752. The charter names the place where judgment was given.

note.de: Lobas Schenkung wird in einer Urkunde aus der Pfalz von Verberie verhandelt.
note.en: The case about Loba’s gift is recorded at the palace of Verberie.
